programme.title: West Side Story
programme.desc: Winner of ten Academy Awards including Best Picture, this electrifying musical sets the ageless tragedy of 'Romeo and Juliet' in the slums of 1950s New York and stars Natalie Wood, Richard Beymer, Russ Tamblyn, Rita Moreno, and George Chakiris.

programme.title: Operation Petticoat
programme.desc: A submarine captain and his supply officer are determined to get their dry-dock sub back into WWII action. However, a bevy of nurses comes aboard, causing hijinks in the hot pink sub.

programme.title: Run Silent, Run Deep
programme.desc: The legendary Clark Gable and Burt Lancaster star in this gripping, classic military drama as a submarine commander (Gable) drives his men and his 1st officer (Lancaster) to the brink of mutiny in his quest to sink an enemy sub. Robert Wise directs.

programme.title: Grindhouse: Planet Terror/Death Proof
programme.desc: In this Robert Rodriguez/Quentin Tarantino tribute to ’70s exploitation films, a go-go dancer kills zombies in Planet Terror, and a stuntman stalks and kills women in Death Proof.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol 1
programme.desc: The Bride wakes up after a long coma. The baby that she carried before entering the coma is gone. The only thing on her mind is to take revenge on the assassination team that betrayed her - a team she was once part of.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Volume 2
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino completes the quest for revenge started in KILL BILL: VOL. 1. The Bride (Uma Thurman) crosses the final names off her death list in KILL BILL: VOL. 2.

programme.title: 30 Days of Night: Dark Days
programme.desc: Almost a year has passed since vampires decimated Barrow, Alaska’s population. Stella, mourning her husband’s murder, has been traveling the world trying to convince others that vampires exist.

programme.title: Deep Blue Sea
programme.desc: One of nature's most perfect killing machines has been re-engineered as something smarter, faster, and deadlier. When things go wrong, the aquatic killing machines begin hunting their creators, who are alone and adrift on the Deep Blue Sea.

programme.title: Dark Tide
programme.desc:
Kate accepts a lucrative opportunity to lead a thrill-seeking millionaire businessman on a shark dive in the most dangerous waters, outside the cage.
PG-13

programme.title: Last Holiday
programme.desc: Upon learning of a terminal illness, a shy woman (Queen Latifah) decides to sell off all her possessions and live it up at a posh European hotel.

programme.title: Antwone Fisher
programme.desc: A troubled sailor who embarks on a remarkable journey to confront his past.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Ip Man is the award-winning film adaptation about the life story of Ip Man, the grandmaster of the Wing Chun style of kung fu and sifu of legendary martial arts superstar, Bruce Lee.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: Newly arrived in Hong Kong, martial arts instructor Ip Man encounters stiff opposition when he begins teaching the Wing Chun fighting style. But instead of bowing to his rivals' demands, he perseveres and retaliates with amazing speed and power.

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: In this explosive third installment of the blockbuster martial arts series, when a band of brutal gangsters led by crooked property developer (Mike Tyson) make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.

programme.title: 40 Dates and 40 Nights
programme.desc: Burned out on dating and ready to quit, Leah takes her eccentric grandma's outrageous challenge—40 dates in 40 nights for a full year of paid rent.

programme.title: That Thing You Do!
programme.desc: Are you ready to rock n' roll? The Wonders are here to take you back to a simpler time when being famous was a bit more innocent.

programme.title: This Is Spinal Tap
programme.desc: Undoubtedly the funniest film ever made about rock and roll, Rob Reiner's satire about an over-the-hill heavy metal band is a priceless look at the music business and its madness.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: A man tries to transport an ancient gun called The Mexican, believed to carry a curse, back across the border, while his girlfriend pressures him to give up his criminal ways.

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc: In a tale of love lost and found again, two ordinary people are rendered extraordinary by the strength, power, and beauty of true love.

programme.title: A Star Is Born (2018)
programme.desc: In this new take on the tragic love story, musician Jackson Maine discovers—and falls in love with—struggling artist Ally. But even as Ally's career takes off, their relationship is breaking down.

programme.title: The Pelican Brief
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Julia Roberts and Denzel Washington star in this thriller about a young law student whose theory about the recent deaths of two Supreme Court justices embroils her in a web of greed, corruption, and murder.

programme.title: Body of Lies
programme.desc: Leonardo Di Caprio and Academy Award winner Russell Crowe star in director Ridley Scott's adaptation of the best-selling post-9/11 espionage thriller.

programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: Academy Award nominees Leonardo DiCaprio and Djimon Hounsou join Academy Award winner Jennifer Connelly in this action drama from Ed Zwick, the filmmaker behind The Last Samurai.

programme.title: Any Given Sunday
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Al Pacino and Cameron Diaz lead a stellar cast in Oscar-winning Oliver Stone's hard-hitting homage to the gridiron gladiators of Any Given Sunday.

programme.title: House of Gucci
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of the family behind the Italian fashion empire. When Patrizia Reggiani marries into the Gucci family, her unbridled ambition begins to unravel the family legacy and triggers a spiral of betrayal, decadence, and murder.

programme.title: While We're Young
programme.desc: Josh and Cornelia, happily married middle-aged creatives in NYC, have given up on starting a family. When they meet a free-spirited young couple, Josh and Cornelia throw aside friends their own age to trail after the uninhibited hipsters.

programme.title: Dances With Wolves
programme.desc: After encountering and eventually being accepted by a Native American tribe, Dunbar's loyalties are put to the test when the army threatens his new home, forcing him to choose between white America or the natives he now calls his people.

programme.title: Geronimo: An American Legend
programme.desc: An American legend comes to life in this epic Western, starring Jason Patric, Robert Duvall, Gene Hackman, and Wes Studi as Geronimo, who delivers a stunning performance as the fearless warrior who was the last Indian leader to surrender to the white man.

programme.title: The Quick and the Dead
programme.desc: In this edgy and darkly humorous Western, a mysterious young woman rides into the lawless town of Redemption to settle an old score that has haunted her since childhood. She becomes swept up in a deadly quick-draw tournament. Rated: R

programme.title: G.I. Joe: The Rise of Cobra
programme.desc: They are G.I. Joe, a top-secret elite strike force featuring the best operatives from around the globe. After the evil Cobra steals a secret weapon, the G.I. Joes must stop Cobra from plunging the world into chaos.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: Retaliation
programme.desc: The greatest American Heroes are back, and they've been set up to take the fall for a heinous crime they didn't commit. Roadblock (Dwayne Johnson) leads a new team (including Channing Tatum and Bruce Willis) on this high-octane adventure.

programme.title: Infinite
programme.desc: Evan McCauley has skills he never learned and memories of places he has never visited. Self-medicated and on the brink of a mental breakdown, a secret group that call themselves Infinites come to his rescue, revealing that his memories are real.

programme.title: The Goonies
programme.desc: With brothers Mikey and Brand's house slated for demolition by greedy developers, the boys' only hope lies in finding a long-lost treasure. They uncover a treasure map and, with their friends, descend to a subterranean sea and an abandoned galleon.

programme.title: The Mummy (1999)
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz star in this nonstop action epic about the discovery of a long-lost treasure in the Egyptian desert that also unearths a 3,000-year-old legacy of terror!

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser and an all-star cast reunite in this action-packed adventure where an accursed mummy is resurrected – along with a force even more powerful: The Scorpion King (The Rock).

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Beauty is both deceiving and dangerous in this dark twist on Hans Christian Andersen's classic tale, as an underwater discovery draws an innocent man into a mermaid's evil world.

programme.title: Child's Play (2019)
programme.desc: In this shocking re-imagining of the horror classic, single mother Karen (Aubrey Plaza) buys her son Andy (Gabriel Bateman) a seemingly innocent, AI-enhanced Buddi doll, unaware of its more sinister nature…and its true name…Chucky!

programme.title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey
programme.desc: Winnie-The-Pooh: Blood and Honey follows Pooh and Piglet as they go on a rampage after Christopher Robin abandons them.

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: This epic drama chronicles J.G. Ballard's remarkable struggle to survive a childhood marked by betrayal, death, and disappointment, while trapped in Shanghai during the Japanese occupation of World War II.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round, and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: The Naked Gun 2 1/2: The Smell of Fear
programme.desc: Lt. Frank Drebin (Leslie Nielsen) loves a mystery. Why are we here? Is there life after sex? Yes, Drebin tackles the big issues— and the biggest of all is how to stop devious Quentin Hapsburg’s (Robert Goulet) plan to destroy the environment!

programme.title: Naked Gun 33 1/3: The Final Insult
programme.desc: Oscar® night. Will someone please kick that numbskull off-stage? Wait! That’s no ordinary numbskull. That’s Lt. Frank Drebin, crashing the ceremonies to stop a terrorist plot!

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino delivers an iconic cast of characters in PULP FICTION, a wildly entertaining tale of violence and redemption. John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, and Bruce Willis star in this pop culture phenomenon.

programme.title: Hotel Artemis
programme.desc: In 2028, Los Angeles is in the midst of the most violent riot in its history. Four bank robbers botch a heist and head to the Hotel Artemis, a penthouse and an ER that exclusively serves criminals – all of whom now set their sights on the robbers.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: A diamond heist gone haywire launches gangsters, bookies, and a dog on a rollicking ride through the rugged world of bare-knuckle boxing in search of the missing stone—a critically acclaimed comedy from Guy Ritchie.

programme.title: Girl Most Likely
programme.desc: Kristen Wiig stars in this sweet and funny movie about a failed playwright who is forced to move home with her eccentric mother (Annette Bening).

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.

programme.title: Thunderheart
programme.desc: Val Kilmer, Sam Shepard, and Graham Greene star in this murder mystery filled with style and suspense. Kilmer stars as Ray Levoi, a hotshot FBI agent who's thrust into a strange new world when he is sent to solve a murder on an Indian reservation.

programme.title: The Brady Bunch Movie
programme.desc: Mike and Carol have just one week to come up with $20,000 in back taxes, or they’ll lose their house to a neighbor. Even worse, Marcia gets a swollen nose on date night, Cindy’s addicted to tattling, and Jan’s hearing a psychotic inner voice.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: A tough cop must pose as a kindergarten teacher to locate a dangerous criminal's ex-wife, who may hold the key to putting him behind bars.

programme.title: Happy Gilmore
programme.desc: A bad-tempered hockey player takes his talent to the golf course to win a tournament prize and save his grandmother's house from the IRS.

programme.title: Escape from Alcatraz
programme.desc: Superstar Clint Eastwood and director Don Siegel re-team for their fifth film in this fascinating account of the only three men ever to escape from the infamous maximum security prison at Alcatraz.

programme.title: Chinatown
programme.desc: Jake Gittes, a private eye, uncovers a web of personal and political scandals while he is hired by a beautiful socialite to investigate her husband's extra marital affair.

programme.title: Boxcar Bertha
programme.desc: Set in the Depression era of the 1930s, a young woman and three men rob trains and plan a kidnapping. The men are caught and the woman becomes a prostitute. Based on "Sister of the Road" by Boxcar Bertha Thomson as told to Ben L. Reitman.

programme.title: Aeon Flux
programme.desc: Academy Award-winner Charlize Theron stars as Aeon Flux, the underground operative fighting totalitarian rule in 25th-century Earth's last living city.

programme.title: The Matrix
programme.desc: When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence. Every second becomes a fight to stay alive - to escape The Matrix.

programme.title: The Matrix Reloaded
programme.desc: In the second chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Zion falls under siege by the Machine Army. Neo and Trinity choose to return to the Matrix with Morpheus. Now, Neo must follow the path he has chosen if he is to save humanity.

programme.title: There Will Be Blood
programme.desc: A sprawling epic about family, faith, power, and oil: the story chronicles the life of Daniel Plainview, who transforms himself from a down-and-out silver miner into a self-made oil tycoon.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on Robert Graysmith's books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Safe
programme.desc: A young girl whose memory holds a priceless numerical code, finds herself pursued. Coming to her aid is an ex-cage fighter whose life was destroyed by the gangsters on Mei's trail.

programme.title: Redemption
programme.desc: Joey, an alcoholic war veteran assumes a new identity after returning from a traumatic tour in Afghanistan and becomes a vigilante in a bid to atone for his sins.

programme.title: Midnight in the Switchgrass
programme.desc: Two FBI agents cross paths with Crawford, a Florida cop who's investigating a string of murders that appear to be related. When an undercover sting goes horribly wrong, Crawford soon finds himself in a twisted game of cat and mouse with the killer.

programme.title: I.Q.
programme.desc: All the world knows about Einstein the scientific genius. But what about Einstein the matchmaker? I.Q. puts this notion to the test and comes up with winning results in this “fun, warmhearted romantic comedy” that has critics and audiences cheering.

programme.title: Sleepless in Seattle
programme.desc: Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan star in an enchanting romance about a widower whose son convinces him to find new love and the woman who answers his call.

programme.title: When Harry Met Sally
programme.desc: As Harry Burns and Sally Albright build their lives and careers in Manhattan, their paths continue to cross, and their friendship continues to grow … until they confront the decision whether to let their friendship develop into romance.

programme.title: Friday
programme.desc: Before the sun sets, Craig must get his friend out of trouble, find a new job so his parents don't evict him, escape his girlfriend long enough to capture a new woman's heart, and survive a confrontation with the neighborhood menace.

programme.title: Next Friday
programme.desc: A streetwise man flees South Central Los Angeles, heading to the suburbs to his lottery-winning uncle and cousin to avoid a neighborhood thug with a grudge who has escaped from prison. But trouble soon follows, and the suburbs will never be the same.

programme.title: Friday After Next
programme.desc: Craig and Day-Day have finally moved into their own apartment, but a ghetto grinch breaks in and steals all their Christmas presents—and the rent money. To avoid eviction before Christmas, the cousins take jobs as unarmed security guards at a strip mall.

programme.title: Star Trek
programme.desc: The greatest adventure of all time begins with Star Trek, the incredible story of a young crew's maiden voyage onboard the most advanced starship ever created: the U.S.S. Enterprise.

programme.title: Star Trek Into Darkness
programme.desc: When a ruthless mastermind, Khan (Benedict Cumberbatch), declares a one-man war on the Federation, Captain Kirk (Chris Pine), Spock (Zachary Quinto), and the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise set out on their most explosive manhunt of all time.

programme.title: Star Trek Beyond
programme.desc: On a rescue mission, the USS Enterprise is attacked by Krall, a warlord sworn against the Federation. Crashed on an uncharted world, the crew must join forces with Jaylah, a rebellious alien warrior, to escape and stop Krall from triggering all-out war.

programme.title: Body of Lies
programme.desc: Leonardo Di Caprio and Academy Award winner Russell Crowe star in director Ridley Scott's adaptation of the best-selling post-9/11 espionage thriller.

programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: Academy Award nominees Leonardo DiCaprio and Djimon Hounsou join Academy Award winner Jennifer Connelly in this action drama from Ed Zwick, the filmmaker behind The Last Samurai.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

programme.title: Rocky II
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Carl Weathers, and Burgess Meredith return for the rematch of the century as Rocky takes on Apollo Creed, even though his doctors advise against it, in this blockbuster sequel that brought audiences to their feet!

programme.title: Rocky III
programme.desc: Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) battles his most powerful adversary yet, Clubber Lang (Mr. T), in this hard-hitting actioner that comes out swinging as Rocky strives to regain the 'eye of the tiger' after a humiliating defeat in the ring.

programme.title: Rocky IV

programme.title: Lady Snowblood
programme.desc: A young woman is trained from birth to be a deadly instrument of revenge against the swindlers who destroyed her family.

programme.title: Lady Snowblood 2: Love Song Of Vengeance

programme.title: That Thing You Do!
programme.desc: Are you ready to rock n' roll? The Wonders are here to take you back to a simpler time when being famous was a bit more innocent.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: A tough cop must pose as a kindergarten teacher to locate a dangerous criminal's ex-wife, who may hold the key to putting him behind bars.

programme.title: Ghosts of Girlfriends Past
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey stars with Jennifer Garner in this romantic comedy about a committed bachelor who gets a wake-up call from his late, legendary, hard-partying Uncle Wayne and his own Ghosts of Girlfriends Past.

programme.title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants
programme.desc: Meet Tibby, Bridget, Lena and Carmen—four teenage best friends who share a pair of secondhand jeans as a unique way of staying connected while separated during a pivotal point in their lives—the summer of their 16th birthdays.

programme.title: Green Room
programme.desc: After witnessing a shocking crime, a young rock band is unexpectedly thrust into a life-or-death battle to escape the clutches of a diabolical club owner (Patrick Stewart) and his ruthless henchmen in this white-knuckle thriller.

programme.title: Double Team
programme.desc: Action superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme joins forces with NBA and media sensation Dennis Rodman in this action-packed thriller. Top counter-terrorist Jack Quinn is ready to get out of the spy game until the evil Stavros kidnaps his wife and unborn son.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Parry, a homeless history professor, lives in a fantasy world full of castles, Red Knights, and damsels in distress. Bridges co-stars as Jack, New York's #1 shock deejay, whose offhand arrogance triggers a tragedy that ruins his career. Rated: R

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: Hercules (2014)
programme.desc: The most towering myth of all time meets up with the mission of a real man in this action-adventure thriller that reveals the famed symbol of courage as he’s never been seen before: finding the hero’s heart that beats beneath his colossal image.

programme.title: Super 8
programme.desc: In the summer of 1979, a group of friends in a small Ohio town witness a catastrophic train crash while making a Super 8 movie and soon suspect that it was not an accident.

programme.title: The Ides of March
programme.desc: Ambition seduces, and power corrupts in a nerve-wracking thriller from Academy Award-nominated director George Clooney (Good Night, and Good Luck). Rating: R

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc: In a tale of love lost and found again, two ordinary people are rendered extraordinary by the strength, power, and beauty of true love.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Beauty is both deceiving and dangerous in this dark twist on Hans Christian Andersen's classic tale, as an underwater discovery draws an innocent man into a mermaid's evil world.

programme.title: X (2022)
programme.desc: A group of actors set out to make an adult film in rural Texas under the noses of their reclusive hosts, but when the elderly couple catches their young guests in the act, the cast finds themselves in a desperate fight for their lives.

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: This epic drama chronicles J.G. Ballard's remarkable struggle to survive a childhood marked by betrayal, death, and disappointment, while trapped in Shanghai during the Japanese occupation of World War II.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round, and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: Set It Off
programme.desc: Jada Pinkett, Queen Latifah, Vivica A. Fox and Kimberly Elise star as four African American women living in a Los Angeles housing project who--pushed to the edge--resort to violence to escape poverty.

programme.title: The Doors
programme.desc: Jim Morrison, one of the most sensual figures in the history of rock and roll, explodes on the screen in “THE DOORS,” the electrifying movie about a time called the sixties and a legendary outlaw who rocked America’s consciousness – forever.

programme.title: At First Sight
programme.desc: AT FIRST SIGHT is the story of a young woman architect who falls in love with a blind man. She encourages him to undergo a radical operation to restore his sight, but ultimately his truest vision comes from the love he finds in his heart.

programme.title: Go
programme.desc: Ronna needs to make some extra cash. Simon wants to escape to Vegas for the weekend. Adam and Zack want to stay out of trouble. But it's not just another night in the life of these unusual characters.

programme.title: Party Girl
programme.desc: In this raucous comedy, Parker Posey ("Scream 3") stars as a hard-partying NY club girl who takes a job as a librarian.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Escape from Alcatraz
programme.desc: Superstar Clint Eastwood and director Don Siegel re-team for their fifth film in this fascinating account of the only three men ever to escape from the infamous maximum security prison at Alcatraz.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: When John Connor sends Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect a young Sarah Connor, unexpected events alter the past and threaten the future of all mankind. Charged with a new mission, Reese must join forces with Sarah and her "Guardian" to save the world.

programme.title: Godzilla (1998)
programme.desc: When the enormous monster descends upon New York, it's up to the Army and an odd team of investigators to unravel the mystery behind the incredible creature before it's too late.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on Robert Graysmith's books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Inherit the Viper
programme.desc: For siblings Kip and Josie, dealing opioids isn't just their family business -- it's their only means of survival. But when a deal goes fatally wrong, Kip ignites a powder keg of violence and betrayal as he tries to quit the life for good.

programme.title: Safe
programme.desc: A young girl whose memory holds a priceless numerical code, finds herself pursued. Coming to her aid is an ex-cage fighter whose life was destroyed by the gangsters on Mei's trail.

programme.title: Redemption
programme.desc: Joey, an alcoholic war veteran assumes a new identity after returning from a traumatic tour in Afghanistan and becomes a vigilante in a bid to atone for his sins.

programme.title: Courage Under Fire
programme.desc: A tank commander reviews another officer's candidacy for a posthumous medal.

programme.title: Against the Ropes
programme.desc: Against the Ropes stars Meg Ryan as Kallen, a sassy, brassy boxing manager-in-the-making determined to change "Lethal" Luther Shaw from a mere street punk into a world-class prizefighter.

programme.title: Beauty Shop (2005)
programme.desc: Gina is a long way from the Barbershop - she's moved from Chicago to Atlanta and buys a rundown salon and inherits a motley group of stylists and a colorful clientele. It's a rocky road to fulfilling her dreams, but you can't keep a good woman down!

programme.title: Barbershop: The Next Cut
programme.desc: It's been more than 10 years since our last appointment at Calvin's Barbershop. Ice Cube, Cedric the Entertainer and the whole crew are back together for a quick trim, some good conversation, a little gossip...and to save their neighborhood!

programme.title: Star Trek Into Darkness
programme.desc: When a ruthless mastermind, Khan (Benedict Cumberbatch), declares a one-man war on the Federation, Captain Kirk (Chris Pine), Spock (Zachary Quinto), and the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise set out on their most explosive manhunt of all time.

programme.title: Star Trek Beyond
programme.desc: On a rescue mission, the USS Enterprise is attacked by Krall, a warlord sworn against the Federation. Crashed on an uncharted world, the crew must join forces with Jaylah, a rebellious alien warrior, to escape and stop Krall from triggering all-out war.

programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: Academy Award nominees Leonardo DiCaprio and Djimon Hounsou join Academy Award winner Jennifer Connelly in this action drama from Ed Zwick, the filmmaker behind The Last Samurai.

programme.title: Rocky
programme.desc: As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

programme.title: Rocky II
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Carl Weathers, and Burgess Meredith return for the rematch of the century as Rocky takes on Apollo Creed, even though his doctors advise against it, in this blockbuster sequel that brought audiences to their feet!

programme.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead (2024)
programme.desc: Tanya finds her summer plans canceled when her mom jets off for a last-minute retreat, and the elderly babysitter who arrives at her door unexpectedly passes away.

programme.title: Last Holiday
programme.desc: Upon learning of a terminal illness, a shy woman (Queen Latifah) decides to sell off all her possessions and live it up at a posh European hotel.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom

programme.title: Blue Chips

In return he throws a bombshell on Seoyeong as well.

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.7
programme.desc: "Seoyeong visits her mother's hometown to bury her ashes and runs into Ujae who secretly followed her. Meanwhile Hojeong continues to do what she can to try and get Sangu's attention whilst Seoyeong's dad runs into trouble again and his daughter finally confronts him about why she hates him. In the end Ujae's mother discovers the photos that Ujae took of Seoyeong and the family go into an interrogation about Seoyeong's background. The heartbreaking and ardent love of Lee Sam-jae, Seo-young's father, for his daughter is depicted in this weekend drama, highlighting the preciousness of parental love. It teaches us that family is interconnected not only by blood but also by love."

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.8
programme.desc: Samjae continues to work hard as a hall manager to save money and face but ends up at the police station much to Seoyeong's disappointment. Hojeong gets busted for being in love which will lead to dire consequences for her. Seongjae finds out what's been going on with his brother and his tutor and why she has to quit. He relieves his stress the only way he knows how... Which is to go on a shopping spree... Just like his mother. Migyeong finds out the truth behind her boyfriend and Ujae gives up on Seoyeong in the end.

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.9
programme.desc: Ujae's mother goes on a hunger strike to try and prevent Ujae's marriage but in the end she strikes a deal that forces Seoyeong to back away. Ujae's at his wits end because he's done everything he can to win Seoyeong's heart. He knows she loves him and her pride and fear are keeping her away. In the end he decides that he can't do anything for her and leaves for the U.S. Meanwhile Hojeong tried desperately to meet Sangu one last time to return his handkerchief only to discover that his father's sick. She ends up nursing him and gets to see Sangu who confirms that he doesn't like her but doesn't hate her either. This is good enough for her.

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.10
programme.desc: Seoyeong is determined to maintain her lie about going overseas. There is no way she can confess to Ujae that she lied about her father. Sangu is distraught at her decision but can't help her out. There is no way that he can disown his father no matter how much he has hated him too. In the midst of this Hojeong agrees to go to the U.S. with the promise that after she returns she can do whatever she wants. In the end Samjae goes to be a pretend guest at a VIP's wedding... The twist is shocking!

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.11
programme.desc: It's been 3 years since the last episode... Jiseon has a hard time adjusting to her perfect daughter-in-law... What every other mother-in-law would be happy about, she finds a burden and complains to Gapsun. Meanwhile Hojeong returns from the U.S., bringing back a man with her that she's sure her mother will accept. Migyeong is now dating Sangu and considering marriage whilst Seoyeong has to handle a major case and continues to grow weary of being a judge. Samjae is the one who is truly doing well with himself, having paid of his debts and worked hard to become a decent father. Perhaps he hopes for the day he'll be reunited with his daughter.

programme.title: Tom Mabe
programme.desc: Tom has been profiled in People magazine, called "gut-busting hilarious" by The New York Times, and given a perfect 4-star rating by the New York Post. He's been featured on radio shows from Hollywood to Dollywood, including "Bob&Tom", Johnboy & Billy "BillHandel" and "Drew&Mike". Chances are you also know Tom as the star of CMT's hit comedy series, "Mabe in America", or have watched one of his popular viral videos. With more than 50-million views on YouTube, Tom is one of the most downloaded people on the planet. People love Tom's stories about coping with life's challenges, ranging from a child with a microscopic attention span to a family vacation in a minivan that takes a wrong turn. His original songs, stories, and videos make for a night out you will remember for years.

programme.title: Collin Moulton
programme.desc: Collin is one of the most fun, personable, and sought after headliners today. He has had his own stand-up special on SHOWTIME, he's been on NICKELODEON, and was recently featured on LAST CALL WITH CARSON DALY. Touring for over 15 years Collin has gained an ease and enjoyment on stage that makes every show worth watching.America knows and loves him. His familiarity and energy engages and relieves the audience before he even speaks. His electric storytelling style makes you care about every topic he explores. Collin's comedy is the release needed from our every day lives. Come needing to laugh tonight, leave wanting to laugh forever!

programme.title: Mike Paramore
programme.desc: Mike Paramore is the guy you fight to sit next to in a movie theatre, on a long car ride, or during a boring lecture. His natural ability to infuse everyday situations with energetic, uplifting humor, combined with a natural ability to put you at ease is key to his personal brand of comedy. His smooth delivery and? powerful punchlines make him a force in stand-up comedy, which is very apparent in his debut album "The Things We Tell Ourselves", available now on iTunes and Amazon. Mike has opened for comedians like Damon Wayans, Cash Cab's Ben Baily, Jon Lovitz, and Saturday Night Live's Jay Pharoah.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Maceo Parker
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove', he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result? Overheated concert halls, with enthusiastic audiences that completely surrender themselves to the music's boundless energy.

programme.title: Chet Baker
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: La Velle
programme.sub-title: Rhoda Scott & La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. "It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.” This performance at the French Festival Jazz à Vienne is extra special. Not only because of the beautiful location, but also because she shares the stage with American gospel and blues singer La Velle. Together they give an intimate and beautiful show in the antique theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella
programme.sub-title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday. In 1971, Marvin Gaye released a major record in the history of soul music "What's Going On". Sly Johnson, accompanied by Nicholas Vella's keyboard, makes the hot music of this album groove, a monument of soul and rhythm'n'blues. A true message of love delivered by MarvinGaye, through the story of a Vietnam war veteran who returns home and sees only injustice, suffering and hatred. The abrasive groove of Sly Johnson and Nicholas Vella is a rich music at the crossroads of hip-hop, funk and jazz. Sly Johnson, a great regular of the stage, embarks with extreme generosity the audience in his musical universe, an irresistible performance.

programme.title: Archie Shepp All Star
programme.sub-title: Archie Shepp All Star - Tribute to John Coltrane
programme.desc: In 1960, Archie Shepp attended a concert of John Coltrane at the Five Spot, legendary club of the Lower East Side. Fascinated, he quickly decided to devote himself to the tenor saxophone. Five years later, Shepp - already a staple of free jazz - finally recorded alongside his idol. The result, published in 1966, is called Ascension and still remains today a symbol of free improvisation. At the edge of the fiftieth anniversary of Coltrane's death, gone at forty, the most Parisian of the New York avant-garde celebrates the legacy of the great composer of A Love Supreme with a dazzling French-American all-star who is reminiscent in some respects of the heretic Ascension orchestra. When a giant pays tribute to a god of jazz...

programme.title: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Ludwig Wicki, Danish National Symphony Orchestra, DR Junior Choir & Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Ludwig Wicki leads the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and the DR Junior Choir in a sparkling concert program of film music. The program features a selection of music from great and Oscar-winning Hollywood films, including Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart, and Moulin Rouge, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner, and Klaus Badelt. Highlights include ‘He's a pirate/Davy Jones' from Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest ‘Now We Are Free' from Gladiator ‘My Heart Will Go On' from Titanic and ‘Shallow' from A Star Is Born. Featured soloists in this concert are the young talented singers Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger and Diluckshan Jeyaratnam. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2022.

programme.title: Jos van Immerseel, Anima Eterna Brugge, Claron McFadden & Bart Van Caenegem
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin's symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928). After, soprano Claron McFadden joins the orchestra, presenting a selection of Gershwin's classic jazz songs, including ‘The man I love' (1924-27), ‘I got rhythm' (1930), and ‘By Strauss' (1936). She also performs ‘My man's gone now' and ‘Summertime' from Porgy and Bess. The concert ends with Gershwin's celebrated Rhapsody in Blue, with Bart Van Caenegem as featured pianist. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.

programme.title: Isabel Schwartzbach, Eivør Pálsdóttir & Adam Riis
programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Fabio Luisi, Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir & MDR Leipzig Radio Choir
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the "Symphony of a Thousand." The work was composed at Mahler's Maiernigg villa in southern Austria in the summer of 1906 and is the last work which was premiered in Mahler's lifetime. Soloists include Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Henriette Bonde-Hansen (soprano), Sofia Fomini (soprano), Marianne Beate Kielland (alto), Olesya Petrova (alto), Stefan Vinke (tenor), Russel Braun (baritone), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Among the participating choirs are the Danish National Concert Choir, MDR Leipzig Radio Choir and Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir. Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. Completed in 1802, the work saw its first performance at the Theater an der Wien on April 5, 1803. That same concert also included the premieres of the composer's Piano Concerto No. 3 and his only oratorio, Christ on the Mount of Olives, as well as a reprise performance of his Symphony No. 1. Instead of the traditional minuet, Beethoven wrote a lively scherzo as the third movement of his Symphony No 2. The overall mood of the work is optimistic. Jordan's performance was recorded at Palais Garnier in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: John Mellencamp
programme.desc: John Mellencamp's career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation. Filmed at the landmark Chicago Theatre, just 250 miles away from his upbringing in Indiana, this cinematic concert documentary film captures John Mellencamp reflecting on his career accompanied by self-narration from his highly personal audio diary on his Midwestern upbringing, career and outlook on life as a whole. Meant to be more than just your run of the mill concert film, this intimate performance with full band will fully envelop the viewer into the Mellencamp mindset. “My vision was true, and my heart was too. And there was no end to what I could dream. Life is short, even in its longest days.”

The shows also featured favourite tracks from across their lengthy career and two recent ones. As ever the concerts were a visual feast and sounded great with the band playing at the top of their form.

programme.desc: When a national day of mourning in London for a fallen leader turns into a horrific terrorist attack, the clock begins ticking for Mike Banning, a seasoned Secret Service agent, and President Asher. What starts as a solemn funeral quickly devolves into chaos as heavily armed insurgents storm the event, resulting in unprecedented violence across the city. Banning, determined to save the President, navigates through a landscape filled with misinformation and danger, uncovering a deeper conspiracy led by the vengeful arms dealer Aamir Barkawi, whose ties to global terrorism threaten more than just the safety of those physically present. With the breakdown of communication channels and infiltration of key security measures, the protagonist must rely on quick thinking and adrenaline-fueled action to outsmart the enemy. The lives of countless civilians are at stake as Banning engages in a tense battle against time, aiming not only to rescue the President but also to dismantle a profoundly dangerous network designed to sow chaos and destruction worldwide. programme.title: Catherine Cohen: Come For Me
programme.desc: In this acclaimed one-woman show, comedian and cabaret star Catherine Cohen delivers a sharp, musical, and self-aware exploration of modern womanhood. Blending stand-up, original songs, and theatrical flair, Cohen takes the audience through her thoughts on dating, therapy, faith, and self-image — all with biting wit, charm, and glitter. Filmed live in New York City, Come For Me celebrates confidence, vulnerability, and the chaos of being thirty and thriving.

programme.desc: P!NK performs a high-energy 2013 concert in Melbourne, featuring acrobatics, pyrotechnics, and hits like So What and Try.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Multi-platinum artist Darius Rucker joins Joel Madden to reflect on his journey from fronting Hootie & the Blowfish to becoming a country music icon. Rucker opens up about balancing family and touring, the band’s legacy, and the honesty that drives his songwriting. He also discusses breaking barriers in country music and his new memoir, Life’s Too Short, offering heartfelt insight into perseverance and authenticity.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Dasha. Born in San Luis Obispo, California, Dasha started performing at ten and released her first song at thirteen. After years as an independent artist, her 2023 single "Austin (Boots Stop Workin')" went viral and landed her a deal with Warner Records. Since then, she's made her Grand Ole Opry debut, joined the Spotify Billions Club, and toured with Thomas Rhett and Luke Bryan.

programme.title: Nos Amis
programme.desc: Nos Amis follows Eagles of Death Metal members Jesse Hughes and Josh Homme as they recount their experiences before, during, and after the 2015 terrorist attack at the Bataclan Theatre in Paris. Blending intimate interviews, archival footage, and emotional reflection, the documentary explores trauma, friendship, and the unifying power of rock and roll.

Together they explore meditation, conscious living, and how self-awareness and emotional intelligence can transform relationships, business, and personal growth.

programme.title: Silent Sacrifice: Stories of Japanese American Incarceration
programme.desc: In 1942, President Roosevelt signed Executive Order 9066 that cleared the way for the incarceration of Japanese Americans in U.S. confinement camps. Men, women, and children of Japanese ancestry were evicted from the West Coast of the United States and held in sites across the country. Learn how American citizens of Japanese descent were affected, what their thoughts were in the face of Pearl Harbor and the declaration of war with Japan, Germany and Italy.

programme.title: Silent Sacrifice: Stories of Japanese American Incarceration
programme.desc: For more than 75 years, the story of Japanese Incarceration has been an untold chapter of American history. Life in the Assembly Centers and Incarceration Camps is revealed through first-hand accounts by former internees and their descendants, relatives and friends, art, letters, music, sports, clothing and more. After release from camps, the former internees travel home wherever that ended up being. What happened to those who lost all but what they could carry? How did they recover and overcome seemingly insurmountable obstacles?

programme.title: Corpsman! Pearl Harbor
programme.desc: Harry Chandler arrived at Pearl Harbor in September 1941, serving as a United States Navy Corpsman. He believed his time in Hawaii would be paradise, a stark contrast to the cold winters of New England. However, on December 7, 1941, Harry's world was shaken by the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor and the island of Oahu. On that Day of Infamy, his duty became saving lives and retrieving charred bodies from the harbor's waters. Corpsman! Pearl Harbor, narrated by sports commentator Jim Nantz, follows Harry's story on that day and the days that followed America's sudden entry into World War II, while also examining the role of corpsmen and medics during the war.

programme.title: The Portillo Expedition: Mystery on the Bougainville Island
programme.desc: THE PORTILLO EXPEDITION: MYSTERY ON BOUGAINVILLE ISLAND examines the circumstances surrounding the death of Isoroku Yamamoto the Japanese WWII Admiral who planned the Pearl Harbor surprise attack and the Battle at Midway. Admiral Yamamotos plane, the Betty Bomber, was shot down by American P-38 fighter planes in 1943. Narrated by Gary Sinise, the documentary follows a crew of American explorers to the remote jungle of the western Solomon Islands, where they search for the wreck of the Betty Bomber sparking a further quest to understand what they find there.

programme.title: Stories of Survival
programme.desc: In early summer 1944, at the apex of the deportation of Hungarian Jews, Magda Brown and George Brent arrived as teenagers to the notorious Auschwitz-Birkenau killing center. Through their eyes, this film takes the viewer on a compelling journey across multiple countries and camps, revealing the intensely human aspects of survival, resistance, chance, and luck in the face of Nazi tyranny.

programme.title: Swimming in Auschwitz
programme.desc: A gripping documentary, SWIMMING IN AUSCHWITZ sheds light on the Holocaust experience from the rarely explored perspective of six women imprisoned inside the Auschwitz-Birkenau concentration camp. The intertwined stories of survivors Eva Beckmann, Rena Drexler, Renee Firestone, Erika Jacoby, Lili Majzner and Linda Sherman illustrate their individual, yet universal, Holocaust experiences.The womens lives slowly morphed into a never-ending saga of persecution and ghettoization. Starting in 1942, Nazis herded Jewish women from Poland, Czechoslovakia, Hungary and Holland onto cattle cars and transported them through the gates of Auschwitz-Birkenau. Separated from family after three or more days on a train with no food or water, stripped of their clothes, their heads shaved and their arms tattooed, they often spent the first night outdoors with the smell of the crematoria in the air.In the ensuing months, their survival within the camp depended largely on luck, yet the six women just teenagers at the time found ways to keep their hope alive. The prisoners maintained a spiritual resistance through prayer, community, music and even humor. Through surprising anecdotes, these women reveal the unlikely role laughter played in their survival. The film's title derives from its most powerful story. Marching through the camp on a particularly hot August day, the group passed by a swimming pool kept for Nazi officers. For one of the women, this sight was just too tempting. To the shock of the rest of the group, she jumped in the pool and swam from one end to the other.The compelling testimonials in this film demonstrate the Nazis' failure to crush the will of Jews. The women profiled do not dwell on the physical and emotional hardships; instead, they speak of camp families and faith, and the ways in which they tried to uplift one another and retain their humanity. Their stories reveal the power of laughter and community, even in the face of unimaginable evil.

programme.title: Shanghai 1937: Where World War II Began
programme.desc: When did World War II begin? For Europeans, it was September 1, 1939 when Nazi Germany invaded Poland. Americans might say December 7, 1941the day the Japanese Imperial navy attacked the American naval base at Pearl Harbor, Hawaii. But in China, people will tell you a different dateAugust 13, 1937, the start of the Battle of Shanghai. That day, after what is called the century of humiliation, including six years of incidents initiated by the Japanese military, China at last stood up.At the time, Shanghai was the most international city in Asia with a large foreign population, so the military conflict made headline news around the world. Based on the book Shanghai 1937: Stalingrad on the Yangtze by Danish author Peter Harmsen, SHANGHAI 1937: WHERE WORLD WAR II BEGAN introduces key figures in the conflict, chronicles how the battle unfolded over the course of three months, and explores the aftermath and years of war that followed. SHANGHAI 1937 incorporates rarely seen archival footage as well as interviews with author Peter Harmsen, military historian Edward Drea and professor of modern Chinese history Hans Van DeVen, in addition to two Chinese experts on this subject: Su Zhiliang, Ph.D. of Shanghai Normal University, and Ma Zhendu, director of the Second Historical Archives of China. The film also includes vivid recollections of men and women who experienced these events as foreign children living in Shanghai.
